work:oakminder.dek: It started with the moment most productivity apps mishandle: a reminder fires while I am already doing something else. I built a productivity AI agent with a voice-agent core for that follow-through moment, then built the distribution studio around it: TikTok research, UGC briefs, source extraction, creative drafts, and feedback that sharpened the product story.
work:oakminder.category: Productivity AI agent, voice agent, distribution studio

cover.alt: Oakminder cover artwork for the productivity AI agent and distribution studio case study

systemMap.label: Productivity agent app
systemMap.description: The App Store live Expo app handles onboarding, agenda views, reminder creation, voice entry, settings, paywall routing, notifications, alarms, and Live Activity.

systemMap.label: Backend state
systemMap.description: Convex owns reminder records, recurrence, completion, devices, notification scheduling, premium access, AI credits, and backend actions.

systemMap.label: Identity and billing
systemMap.description: Clerk identifies the account. RevenueCat and Water Drops make subscription access and AI usage visible inside the product model.

systemMap.label: Native urgency
systemMap.description: Push, APNs/FCM, notification actions, AlarmKit, Live Activity, and silent cleanup keep reminders visible and synchronized.

systemMap.label: Voice agent actions
systemMap.description: Gemini / Vertex AI turns voice into structured reminder and category actions that land back in app state.

systemMap.label: Product documentation
systemMap.description: Mintlify-style docs, llms.txt, and MCP make the product easier for people and AI tools to understand.

systemMap.label: Distribution studio
systemMap.description: The internal studio tracks product context, TikTok and UGC research, competitors, creators, hooks, drafts, creative assets, exports, and feedback.

systemMap.label: Research bridge
systemMap.description: Mobile and desktop surfaces move TikTok links, traces, transcripts, frames, OCR text, and account tags back into the studio.

systemMap.label: Creative production
systemMap.description: Slideshow editing, caption rewrite, image workflows, hook factory, Remotion video editing, mobile review, and Postiz handoff turn research into testable assets.

work:ecosmartloop.dek: EcoSmartLoop started with the awkward pause before someone guesses between recycling, compost, and landfill. The scale behind that pause was bigger: UNEP puts the 2050 waste-cost risk at $640.3B, and California SB 1383 planning uses 450,000 businesses. My team’s SFBU capstone turned LEAF Engine classification into Orbi AI guidance, rewards, web/iOS UX, and organization feedback.
